blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The police in Mimaropa have accounted for 216 loose firearms since May as the regional police chief ordered intensified operations against illegal gun possession and gun-related violence ahead of the Undas observance. Police Brig. Gen. Christopher R. Dela Cruz, Mimaropa regional police director, issued the directive during an October 27 command conference, tasking police commanders to strengthen law enforcement, coordinate with local governments and mobilize communities to prevent firearm-related incidents.
